name: What is crown molding and why should I install it?

mainEntity.name: What is crown molding and why should I install it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crown molding is a decorative trim applied to the top of interior walls, where they meet the ceiling. It enhances a room's aesthetic by adding architectural detail and can conceal minor imperfections at the wall-ceiling joint. Installing crown molding can elevate the perceived value and finish of your home, contributing to a more polished look. Consider it if you're aiming to improve your home's interior aesthetics and desire a more elegant, customized feel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Crown molding is a decorative trim that adds architectural detail where walls meet the ceiling, enhancing a room's aesthetic and perceived value.
